topic: 2025 FID and EPCC award / construction start
wiki_text: On 24 June 2025, the Extraordinary General Meeting of shareholders of Gulf MTP LNG Terminal Co Ltd (GMTP) approved proceeding with the Map Ta Phut Phase 3 LNG terminal at a total investment not exceeding THB 60,000 million (~US$1.8 billion). GMTP is a joint venture of Gulf Energy Development (70%) and PTT Tank (30%), the latter an affiliate of state-owned PTT. On 1 July 2025, GMTP signed an EPCC contract with the PEC-CAZ Consortium (POSCO Eco & Challenge Company and CAZ Thailand) for the terminal superstructure on ~200 rai of reclaimed land at Map Ta Phut Port. The first phase has 8 mtpa of regasification capacity, expandable to 10.8 mtpa. Superstructure construction was scheduled to begin in Q4 2025 with commercial operations targeted for Q1 2029.
